📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 16 | : HLOOKUP | : Create a small horizontal lookup table (see Solutions sheet for layout) and use HLOOKUP to retrieve the Salary for 'HR'.

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: ── LOGICAL ──

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 17 | : IF | : Write an IF formula: if an employee's Sales_Achieved >= Sales_Target, return 'Met', else 'Missed'. Apply to E002 (row 3).

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 18 | : IF | : Write an IF formula: if Salary > 60000 return 'Senior', else 'Junior'. Apply to E003 (row 4).

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 19 | : Nested IF | : Rating 5='Excellent', Rating 4='Good', Rating 3='Average', else='Poor'. Apply to E001 (row 2).

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 21 | : MEDIAN | : Calculate the median Salary.

📝 Excel Practice Questions – Employee Data: 22 | : MODE | : Calculate the mode of the Rating column (Column K).
